CIRC-2026-001.scope_of_work: Procurement, configuration, cluster orchestration, benchmark testing and 3-year on-site SLA warranty for GPU Compute Nodes and 100Gbps InfiniBand Switching Fabric.

items.description: GPU Compute Node (2x Intel Xeon Gold, 4x NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada 48GB, 512GB ECC RAM)
100 Gbps HDR InfiniBand Managed Switch (36 ports) with DAC cables
High-Speed NVMe Storage Head (64TB Raw NVMe RAID array)

eligibility_criteria: Must be an authorized tier-1 OEM partner for compute and accelerator hardware
Minimum 5 years demonstrated experience in enterprise/university HPC installations
Valid Trade License, Tax Identification Certificate, and Audited Financials for the last 2 years
Ability to furnish 5% Performance Security upon contract signing
required_documents: Priced Financial Proposal with BOQ breakdown

CIRC-2026-002.scope_of_work: Supply and calibration of research-grade UV-Vis Double Beam Spectrophotometers with peltier temperature controllers and microplate absorbance readers.

items.description: Dual-Beam UV-Vis Spectrophotometer with Peltier System
Quartz cuvette sets, calibration standards, and workstation PC

eligibility_criteria: Accredited ISO 9001 certified laboratory instrument vendor
Factory-trained technical support engineers available locally
Minimum 3 client endorsements from accredited research universities

CIRC-2026-003.scope_of_work: Turnkey network backbone deployment including fiber laying across 6 campus faculties, core routing configuration, and 10Gbps uplinks.

items.description: Single-Mode Armored Outdoor Optical Fiber Cable (24 Core)
Enterprise Core Switch 48-port SFP+ 10Gbps with redundant PSU
Outdoor Weatherproof Wi-Fi 6 APs with POE+ Injectors

eligibility_criteria: Certified Network System Integrator (Gold or Platinum partner)
Over 10km optical fiber deployment track record in campus/enterprise environment

CIRC-2026-004.scope_of_work: Automation of Central Library loan, return, catalog search and inventory audits using HF RFID technology.

items.description: Self-Service Touchscreen Checkout Kiosk with receipt printer
Library Book RFID Adhesive Tags (roll of 20,000 tags)

eligibility_criteria: Proven Koha / DSpace library software integration experience
Local spare parts availability and 24/7 hotline support
